name_en: Kurozukuri — squid fermented in its own ink
summary_ja: スルメイカの身とキモをイカスミで和え、冷蔵庫で熟成させる塩辛。加賀藩主が将軍家に献上したという記録が残るとされ、一般的な赤づくりより生臭さが少なくまろやかな塩味という。
summary_en: Squid meat and liver are mixed with the squid's own ink and left to cure in the refrigerator — said to have once been presented to the shogunate by the Kaga domain's lord, and, compared with ordinary salted squid, milder in both fishiness and salt.
source_title: 黒づくり 富山県｜うちの郷土料理
